Sulphur Terebinthinatum.



Terebinthinated Sulphur. [One part of purified Sulphur is dissolved by
        heating in one hundred parts of Turpentine.] Dilutions.



Clinical. ─   Chorea. Chronic rheumatic arthritis.



Characteristics. ─     Sul.
        tereb  . is referred to in the Hon. Robert Boyle's works (Shaw's edition, vol. iii.
        584). A 1x dilution cured a most obstinate case of St. Vitus's dance, and has often relieved
        pain in chronic rheumatic arthritis (Cooper).
